pure-announcement.rationale: This is Databricks's own launch PR for its product — 'Introducing Omnigent... today we're open sourcing... star the repo, join Discord' — and its transferable-sounding 'meta-harness layer' framing is the product's category positioning wrapped around an alpha feature list, not third-party coverage of a durable technique.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers a meta-harness above agent harnesses; proxy-boundary-session-capture touches only the adjacent egress-proxy idea, not this post's central claim.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims are about a published Apache-2.0 codebase with linked docs, so a reader can verify what the system does.

durability.rationale: The argument that composition, policy control, and collaboration span individual harnesses may age well, but the note's substance is an alpha product's feature matrix, roadmap items, and deploy-target list that will churn within months.

actionability.rationale: Beyond 'install Omnigent', the reader gets only glimpses of transferable mechanisms (stateful policies like npm-install-then-gate-git-push, egress-proxy credential injection) without enough detail to build from.

atomicity.rationale: One idea carries the whole post — a uniform layer above agent harnesses, justified by the observation that every harness reduces to messages and files in, streams and tool calls out.
